# Eleven — Football Intelligence Platform AI Documentation

This project uses React 19, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Recharts, and Framer Motion. 
It integrates with a FastAPI backend on port 8000 for clustering and similarity inference.

## Key Features
- **Landing Hero**: 100dvh non-F11 locked viewport with full-bleed stadium ambience and weighted relevance fuzzy search.
- **Tactical PCA Pitch Map**: Visualizes high-dimensional player data in 2D space.
- **Percentile Radar Charts**: 8-axis per-90 metrics mapped against positional peers with dual-player comparison.
- **GMM Soft-Clustering Matrix**: 7 unsupervised Gaussian Mixture Model tactical archetypes.
- **U21 Wonderkid Scouting**: Cosine distance similarity scouting for next-gen prospects.
- **AI Scout Chat**: Natural language intent classification and structured football intelligence queries.

## Theme & Anti-Slop
This project strictly enforces `DESIGN.md`. The design system uses Obsidian (`#05080C`), Tactical Orange (`#FF4E32`), and Apple Liquid Glassmorphism, banning generic purple gradients, broken image icons, and fake metrics.
